sources.title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), a novel RL algorithm that achieves fine-grained credit assignment for LLM agents while preserving the appealing properties of group-based RL: critic-free, low memory, and stable convergence.
